node.statement: By lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger, D_* = max{1,D_0,D_1,D_2,D_3}, so D_* >= 1. Applying its global-scalar-call clause at the base scale t := epsilon, using the producer hypotheses from node 1.2.1 and the finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra A fixed at the root, yields the literal map u_0(lambda)=lambda I_A furnished by lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion as an extended D_*t-inclusion with ||u_0(I_C)-I_A|| <= D_*t, and declares this call eligible for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation.
